moments.action: In the dim room Lynn holds a tight, troubled close-up with Bank blurred behind her; by the end she has crossed to the wooden door, turned back for one last look, and is on her way out.
Shot from behind, Lynn is walked through a bare white room past men in suits toward a camcorder standing on a tripod, which the frame settles on.
Two statements straight to camera: Bank speaking in the dim room, then a cut to Lynn's father against a blank white wall, the setting flipping from shadow to clinical light.
Lynn sits across a white table from a suited man while the camcorder records; by the shot's end she has turned her back to him, facing away in her chair.
